name: AStar Electricals
description: A Bengaluru-based electrical services business focused on commercial spaces. We worked with AStar to shape its visual identity—bringing together the letter A and an electrical bolt form—and crafted clear business communication to give them a recognisable, consistent brand presence.
context: AStar Electricals is a Bengaluru-based electrical services business focused on commercial spaces. The business needed an identity that felt clear, recognisable and appropriate to the work it does. We worked with AStar to shape its visual identity and bring consistency to the way it presents itself.

findingIdentity.title: Finding the identity
paragraphs: The identity brings together the letter A and an electrical-inspired bolt form. The intent was to create a mark that is simple, distinctive and easy to recognise.
The visual direction uses midnight blue, gold, black and red as its defining colours, bringing together a sense of reliability and energy without making the identity unnecessarily complicated.

whatWeWorkedOn: Visual identity direction and colour selection.

result.title: The result
paragraphs: A more considered visual identity and a clearer way for AStar Electricals to introduce its business.
The work was about giving the business a recognisable identity that it can use consistently across its communication.
